import sys, json, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from perf import pk, dg, trace, hexs, MAXN
import mem
# ~14 MiB input: 20000 packets, 60000 frames, mostly PING
packets = []
pn = 0
evs = []
while len(evs) < 1250:
    packs = [pk("I", pn, [{"type": "PADDING"}, {"type": "PING"}, {"type": "PING"}]) for _ in range(16)]
    pn += 16
    evs.append(dg(len(evs), 1200, packs))
doc = json.dumps({"version": 1, "traces": [trace("big", evs, idle_ms=0)]}).encode()
print("input bytes:", len(doc))
mem.measure(doc, "14MiB-ish input")
# max hex: 2MiB data in one stream set
evs2 = []
pn = 0
for i in range(1024):
    frames = [{"type": "STREAM", "id": (i % 32) * 4, "offset": (i // 32) * 2048 + j * 32,
               "data_hex": hexs(16, j), "fin": False} for j in range(64)]
    evs2.append(dg(i, 1200, [pk("A", pn, frames)])); pn += 1
doc2 = json.dumps({"version": 1, "traces": [trace("hex", evs2)]}).encode()
print("input2 bytes:", len(doc2), "frames", 1024*64)
mem.measure(doc2, "2MiB decoded data")
